fullText.simplified:
第三章、七国地图

    我接到王的通知，要我去引都。
    家乡距引都其实并不远，坐船只要一天。到引都之后，我先去了兰台。兰台是王和年轻人一起读书的地方，是楚国文化交流的中心。我在那儿见到了楚怀王。
    楚怀王就是楚国的王。他是一个有远大志向的王，一心想把楚国变成最富强的国家。我在心里对自己说，以后好好工作。因为楚怀王强国富民的理想也是我的理想。
    等一下，这里我要暂停一下。我想给你介绍一下楚国和其他国家的情况。
    战国时期，中国分成很多小国。每个国家都有自己的王和军队，国与国之间经常发生战争。小国被大国消灭了，就会成为大国的国土。大国被别的大国消灭了，也会成为消灭它的大国的一部分。到了战国末期，这些国家的数量慢慢变少，最后只有七个了。
    这七个国家就是我前面说过的“七国”：秦国、楚国、齐国、燕国、赵国、韩国和魏国。
    如果前面你已经画好了那幅简单的地图，现在请把它放在手边。这样，接下来读各国的情况时，你会清楚很多。
    西边的秦国，有四百多年历史。他们一直都是强国，但在十多年前，他们发展得不太好。后来出现了一位特别厉害的官员，进行了一场大的改革，让秦国再次成为了强国。现在秦国有七国中最厉害的将军和军队，经常进攻别的小国。
    东边的齐国，也很强大。不但经济好，而且有七国最好的学校。七国许多优秀的学者都在那个学校做过老师或学习过，许多对中国影响深远的思想就是从那儿开始的。
    北边和中间的四个国家——燕国、赵国、韩国、魏国，都是小国，军队和经济都不如另外三国。他们在强大的秦国和齐国中间，过得不太好。
fullText.traditional:
第三章、七國地圖

    我接到王的通知，要我去引都。
    家鄉距引都其實並不遠，坐船只要一天。到引都之後，我先去了蘭臺。蘭臺是王和年輕人一起讀書的地方，是楚國文化交流的中心。我在那兒見到了楚懷王。
    楚懷王就是楚國的王。他是一個有遠大志向的王，一心想把楚國變成最富強的國家。我在心裡對自己說，以後好好工作。因為楚懷王強國富民的理想也是我的理想。
    等一下，這裡我要暫停一下。我想給你介紹一下楚國和其他國家的情況。
    戰國時期，中國分成很多小國。每個國家都有自己的王和軍隊，國與國之間經常發生戰爭。小國被大國消滅了，就會成為大國的國土。大國被別的大國消滅了，也會成為消滅它的大國的一部分。到了戰國末期，這些國家的數量慢慢變少，最後只有七個了。
    這七個國家就是我前面說過的“七國”：秦國、楚國、齊國、燕國、趙國、韓國和魏國。
    如果前面你已經畫好了那幅簡單的地圖，現在請把它放在手邊。這樣，接下來讀各國的情況時，你會清楚很多。
    西邊的秦國，有四百多年歷史。他們一直都是強國，但在十多年前，他們發展得不太好。後來出現了一位特別厲害的官員，進行了一場大的改革，讓秦國再次成為了強國。現在秦國有七國中最厲害的將軍和軍隊，經常進攻別的小國。
    東邊的齊國，也很強大。不但經濟好，而且有七國最好的學校。七國許多優秀的學者都在那個學校做過老師或學習過，許多對中國影響深遠的思想就是從那兒開始的。
    北邊和中間的四個國家——燕國、趙國、韓國、魏國，都是小國，軍隊和經濟都不如另外三國。他們在強大的秦國和齊國中間，過得不太好。

sentences.simplified: 我接到王的通知，要我去引都。
sentences.traditional: 我接到王的通知，要我去引都。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ jiē dào wáng de tōng zhī yào wǒ qù yǐn dū
sentences.english: I received a notice from the king asking me to go to Yindu.

sentences.simplified: 家乡距引都其实并不远，坐船只要一天。到引都之后，我先去了兰台。
sentences.traditional: 家鄉距引都其實並不遠，坐船只要一天。到引都之後，我先去了蘭臺。
sentences.pinyin: jiā xiāng jù yǐn dū qí shí bìng bù yuǎn zuò chuán zhǐ yào yì tiān dào yǐn dū zhī hòu wǒ xiān qù le lán tái
sentences.english: My hometown was actually not far from Yindu, only a day’s journey by boat. After arriving in Yindu, I first went to the Orchid Terrace.

sentences.simplified: 兰台是王和年轻人一起读书的地方，
sentences.traditional: 蘭臺是王和年輕人一起讀書的地方，
sentences.pinyin: lán tái shì wáng hé nián qīng rén yì qǐ dú shū de dì fang
sentences.english: The Orchid Terrace was a place where the king and young people studied together.

sentences.simplified: 是楚国文化交流的中心。我在那儿见到了楚怀王。
sentences.traditional: 是楚國文化交流的中心。我在那兒見到了楚懷王。
sentences.pinyin: shì chǔ guó wén huà jiāo liú de zhōng xīn wǒ zài nà'r jiàn dào le chǔ huái wáng
sentences.english: It was the center of cultural exchanges in the state of Chu. There, I met King Huai of Chu.

sentences.simplified: 楚怀王就是楚国的王。
sentences.traditional: 楚懷王就是楚國的王。
sentences.pinyin: chǔ huái wáng jiù shì chǔ guó de wáng
sentences.english: King Huai of Chu was the king of the state of Chu.

sentences.simplified: 他是一个有远大志向的王，一心想把楚国变成最富强的国家。
sentences.traditional: 他是一個有遠大志向的王，一心想把楚國變成最富強的國家。
sentences.pinyin: tā shì yí ge yǒu yuǎn dà zhì xiàng de wáng yì xīn xiǎng bǎ chǔ guó biàn chéng zuì fù qiáng de guó jiā
sentences.english: He was a king with far-reaching ambitions, determined to make the state of Chu the most prosperous and powerful state.

sentences.simplified: 我在心里对自己说，以后好好工作。
sentences.traditional: 我在心裡對自己說，以後好好工作。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ zài xīn lǐ duì zì jǐ shuō yǐ hòu hǎo hǎo gōng zuò
sentences.english: I told myself in my heart to work hard in the future, ..

sentences.simplified: 因为楚怀王强国富民的理想也是我的理想。
sentences.traditional: 因為楚懷王強國富民的理想也是我的理想。
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi chǔ huái wáng qiáng guó fù mín de lǐ xiǎng yě shì wǒ de lǐ xiǎng
sentences.english: .. because King Huai’s ideal of strengthening the country and enriching the people was also my ideal.

sentences.simplified: 等一下，这里我要暂停一下。我想给你介绍一下楚国和其他国家的情况。
sentences.traditional: 等一下，這裡我要暫停一下。我想給你介紹一下楚國和其他國家的情況。
sentences.pinyin: děng yí xià zhè lǐ wǒ yào zàn tíng yí xià wǒ xiǎng gěi nǐ jiè shào yí xià chǔ guó hé qí tā guó jiā de qíng kuàng
sentences.english: Wait a moment. I’d like to pause here and tell you a bit about the state of Chu and the other states.

sentences.simplified: 战国时期，中国分成很多小国。
sentences.traditional: 戰國時期，中國分成很多小國。
sentences.pinyin: zhàn guó shí qī zhōng guó fēn chéng hěn duō xiǎo guó
sentences.english: During the Warring States period, China was divided into many small states.

sentences.simplified: 每个国家都有自己的王和军队，国与国之间经常发生战争。
sentences.traditional: 每個國家都有自己的王和軍隊，國與國之間經常發生戰爭。
sentences.pinyin: měi ge guó jiā dōu yǒu zì jǐ de wáng hé jūn duì guó yǔ guó zhī jiān jīng cháng fā shēng zhàn zhēng
sentences.english: Each state had its own king and army, and wars frequently broke out between them.

sentences.simplified: 小国被大国消灭了，就会成为大国的国土。
sentences.traditional: 小國被大國消滅了，就會成為大國的國土。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo guó bèi dà guó xiāo miè le jiù huì chéng wéi dà guó de guó tǔ
sentences.english: When a small state was conquered by a larger one, it would become part of the larger state’s territory.

sentences.simplified: 大国被别的大国消灭了，也会成为消灭它的大国的一部分。
sentences.traditional: 大國被別的大國消滅了，也會成為消滅它的大國的一部分。
sentences.pinyin: dà guó bèi bié de dà guó xiāo miè le yě huì chéng wéi xiāo miè tā de dà guó de yí bù fen
sentences.english: When a large state was conquered by another large state, it also became part of the state that conquered it.

sentences.simplified: 到了战国末期，这些国家的数量慢慢变少，最后只有七个了。
sentences.traditional: 到了戰國末期，這些國家的數量慢慢變少，最後只有七個了。
sentences.pinyin: dào le zhàn guó mò qī zhè xiē guó jiā de shù liàng màn man biàn shǎo zuì hòu zhǐ yǒu qī ge le
sentences.english: By the late Warring States period, the number of these states gradually decreased until only seven remained.

sentences.simplified: 这七个国家就是我前面说过的“七国”：
sentences.traditional: 這七個國家就是我前面說過的“七國”：
sentences.pinyin: zhè qī ge guó jiā jiù shì wǒ qián miàn shuō guò de qī guó
sentences.english: These seven states were the “Seven Warring States” that I mentioned earlier:

sentences.simplified: 秦国、楚国、齐国、燕国、赵国、韩国和魏国。
sentences.traditional: 秦國、楚國、齊國、燕國、趙國、韓國和魏國。
sentences.pinyin: qín guó chǔ guó qí guó yān guó zhào guó hán guó hé wèi guó
sentences.english: the state of Qin, the state of Chu, the state of Qi, the state of Yan, the state of Zhao, the state of Han, and the state of Wei.

sentences.simplified: 如果前面你已经画好了那幅简单的地图，现在请把它放在手边。
sentences.traditional: 如果前面你已經畫好了那幅簡單的地圖，現在請把它放在手邊。
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ qián miàn nǐ yǐ jīng huà hǎo le nà fú jiǎn dān de dì tú xiàn zài qǐng bǎ tā fàng zài shǒu biān
sentences.english: If you had already drawn that simple map earlier, please keep it at hand.

sentences.simplified: 这样，接下来读各国的情况时，你会清楚很多。
sentences.traditional: 這樣，接下來讀各國的情況時，你會清楚很多。
sentences.pinyin: zhè yàng jiē xià lái dú gè guó de qíng kuàng shí nǐ huì qīng chu hěn duō
sentences.english: This way, it will be much clearer for you as you read about each state.

sentences.simplified: 西边的秦国，有四百多年历史。
sentences.traditional: 西邊的秦國，有四百多年歷史。
sentences.pinyin: xī biān de qín guó yǒu sì bǎi duō nián lì shǐ
sentences.english: To the west, the state of Qin had a history of over four hundred years.

sentences.simplified: 他们一直都是强国，但在十多年前，他们发展得不太好。
sentences.traditional: 他們一直都是強國，但在十多年前，他們發展得不太好。
sentences.pinyin: tā men yì zhí dōu shì qiáng guó dàn zài shí duō nián qián tā men fā zhǎn de bú tài hǎo
sentences.english: They had always been a strong state, but a little more than ten years ago, their development was not going well.

sentences.simplified: 后来出现了一位特别厉害的官员，进行了一场大的改革，让秦国再次成为了强国。
sentences.traditional: 後來出現了一位特別厲害的官員，進行了一場大的改革，讓秦國再次成為了強國。
sentences.pinyin: hòu lái chū xiàn le yí wèi tè bié lì hai de guān yuán jìn xíng le yì cháng dà de gǎi gé ràng qín guó zài cì chéng wéi le qiáng guó
sentences.english: Later, a particularly capable official emerged and carried out a major reform, making the state of Qin into a strong state again.

sentences.simplified: 现在秦国有七国中最厉害的将军和军队，经常进攻别的小国。
sentences.traditional: 現在秦國有七國中最厲害的將軍和軍隊，經常進攻別的小國。
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài qín guó yǒu qī guó zhōng zuì lì hai de jiāng jūn hé jūn duì jīng cháng jìn gōng bié de xiǎo guó
sentences.english: Now, the state of Qin had the most formidable generals and army of the Seven Warring States and often attacked other smaller states.

sentences.simplified: 东边的齐国，也很强大。
sentences.traditional: 東邊的齊國，也很強大。
sentences.pinyin: dōng bian de qí guó yě hěn qiáng dà
sentences.english: To the east, the state of Qi was also very powerful.

sentences.simplified: 不但经济好，而且有七国最好的学校。
sentences.traditional: 不但經濟好，而且有七國最好的學校。
sentences.pinyin: bú dàn jīng jì hǎo ér qiě yǒu qī guó zuì hǎo de xué xiào
sentences.english: Not only was its economy good, but it also had the best school in all of the Seven Warring States.

sentences.simplified: 七国许多优秀的学者都在那个学校做过老师或学习过，
sentences.traditional: 七國許多優秀的學者都在那個學校做過老師或學習過，
sentences.pinyin: qī guó xǔ duō yōu xiù de xué zhě dōu zài nà ge xué xiào zuò guò lǎo shī huò xué xí guò
sentences.english: Many outstanding scholars from the Seven Warring States taught or studied at that school, ..

sentences.simplified: 许多对中国影响深远的思想就是从那儿开始的。
sentences.traditional: 許多對中國影響深遠的思想就是從那兒開始的。
sentences.pinyin: xǔ duō duì zhōng guó yǐng xiǎng shēn yuǎn de sī xiǎng jiù shì cóng nà'r kāi shǐ de
sentences.english: .. and many ideas with a profound influence on China originated there.

sentences.simplified: 北边和中间的四个国家——燕国、赵国、韩国、魏国，都是小国，
sentences.traditional: 北邊和中間的四個國家——燕國、趙國、韓國、魏國，都是小國，
sentences.pinyin: běi biān hé zhōng jiān de sì ge guó jiā yān guó zhào guó hán guó wèi guó dōu shì xiǎo guó
sentences.english: The four states to the north and in the middle—Yan, Zhao, Han, and Wei—were all small states.

sentences.simplified: 军队和经济都不如另外三国。
sentences.traditional: 軍隊和經濟都不如另外三國。
sentences.pinyin: jūn duì hé jīng jì dōu bù rú lìng wài sān guó
sentences.english: Their armies and economies were weaker than those of the other three states.

sentences.simplified: 他们在强大的秦国和齐国中间，过得不太好。
sentences.traditional: 他們在強大的秦國和齊國中間，過得不太好。
sentences.pinyin: tā men zài qiáng dà de qín guó hé qí guó zhōng jiān guò de bú tài hǎo
sentences.english: In between the powerful states of Qin and Qi, they did not fare well.

sentence_translations: Chapter 3: The Map of the Seven Warring States
I received a notice from the king asking me to go to Yindu.
My hometown was actually not far from Yindu, only a day’s journey by boat. After arriving in Yindu, I first went to the Orchid Terrace.
The Orchid Terrace was a place where the king and young people studied together.
It was the center of cultural exchanges in the state of Chu. There, I met King Huai of Chu.
King Huai of Chu was the king of the state of Chu.
He was a king with far-reaching ambitions, determined to make the state of Chu the most prosperous and powerful state.
I told myself in my heart to work hard in the future, ..
.. because King Huai’s ideal of strengthening the country and enriching the people was also my ideal.
Wait a moment. I’d like to pause here and tell you a bit about the state of Chu and the other states.
During the Warring States period, China was divided into many small states.
Each state had its own king and army, and wars frequently broke out between them.
When a small state was conquered by a larger one, it would become part of the larger state’s territory.
When a large state was conquered by another large state, it also became part of the state that conquered it.
By the late Warring States period, the number of these states gradually decreased until only seven remained.
These seven states were the “Seven Warring States” that I mentioned earlier:
the state of Qin, the state of Chu, the state of Qi, the state of Yan, the state of Zhao, the state of Han, and the state of Wei.
If you had already drawn that simple map earlier, please keep it at hand.
This way, it will be much clearer for you as you read about each state.
To the west, the state of Qin had a history of over four hundred years.
They had always been a strong state, but a little more than ten years ago, their development was not going well.
Later, a particularly capable official emerged and carried out a major reform, making the state of Qin into a strong state again.
Now, the state of Qin had the most formidable generals and army of the Seven Warring States and often attacked other smaller states.
To the east, the state of Qi was also very powerful.
Not only was its economy good, but it also had the best school in all of the Seven Warring States.
Many outstanding scholars from the Seven Warring States taught or studied at that school, ..
.. and many ideas with a profound influence on China originated there.
The four states to the north and in the middle—Yan, Zhao, Han, and Wei—were all small states.
Their armies and economies were weaker than those of the other three states.
In between the powerful states of Qin and Qi, they did not fare well.
